on_screen.content:
CLIP (Contrastive Language-Image Pre-Training) is a neural network trained on a variety of (image, text) pairs.
It can be instructed in natural language to predict the most relevant text snippet, given an image, without being directly optimized for the task.
CLIP jointly trains an image encoder and a text encoder to predict the correct pairings of a batch of (image, text) training examples.

on_screen.content:
def load(name: str = "ViT-B/32", device: str = "cpu"):
    """
    Load a CLIP model and its visual preprocessing transform.
    Returns the loaded neural network model and torchvision preprocessing pipeline.
    """
    model = build_model(name, device=device)
    preprocess = lambda img: img
    return model, preprocess
